topic: Historical session forecasting for company data
summary_markdown:
Someone uploaded data for a specific company (company_num = 7957) covering the period from 2024-11-09 to 2024-11-15. The request is to generate historical forecasts for all facilities belonging to this company, spanning one week at a time. Specifically, sessions for 2024-11-16 should align with 2024-11-09 data, and sessions for 2024-11-17 should align with 2024-11-10 data.

It was noted that a forecast has already been completed for one specific facility (facility_num = 44297), and this can be skipped if it simplifies the process.
decisions: The scope of work is to create historical session forecasts for company 7957.
action_items: [me] will handle the forecasting task after dealing with the Brazilian airport data.
